description: This file implements a MetricsPipeline class that periodically polls network metrics from a Xena client, processes and aggregates the data, handles gaps or non-monotonic timestamps via compensation, and persists the metrics and series samples. It includes methods to start and stop the polling loop, and internal logic for delta calculation, error handling, and observability logging.

classes.name: _LastState
classes.description: Data class holding the last raw snapshot and sequence number for delta calculations.

classes.name: MetricsPipeline
classes.description: Main class responsible for background polling, data aggregation, gap compensation, and persistence of network metrics.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background polling task asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the background polling task asynchronously.

methods.name: _run_loop
methods.description: Internal method running the polling loop, handling timing and exceptions.

methods.name: _poll_once
methods.description: Performs a single poll of metrics, processes data, handles gaps, and updates repositories and observability metrics.
